en: Colorized vintage postcard view over the rooftops of a historic city toward two prominent church towers. In the foreground is a clock tower with a green patinated baroque dome; in the background stands a large neo‑Gothic cathedral with twin spires. At the top margin there is printed text in Croatian: "Zagreb - Pogled sa Štrosmajerovog šetališta." Faint cancellation lines from postal processing are visible in the sky area.
